# TimeIntervalStamp { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp(intervals, source_id, source=None, is_interpolated=False)
```

A synchronized collection of canonical typed timeline intervals.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                                                                         | Description                                   | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|------------|
| intervals       | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Interval](`timetoalign.core.time.Interval`)\] | Timeline-ID to interval mapping.              | _required_ |
| source_id       | [str](`str`)                                                                 | Timeline identity defining the interval axis. | _required_ |
| source          | [TimeStampSource](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeStampSource`) \| None      | Optional object providing conversion maps.    | `None`     |
| is_interpolated | [bool](`bool`)                                                               | Whether any endpoint was estimated.           | `False`    |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [axis](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.axis) | Return the typed interval on the source axis. |
| [duration](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.duration) | Return the typed duration on the source axis. |
| [end](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.end) | Return a derived instant stamp of all interval ends. |
| [present_timelines](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.present_timelines) | Return stored timeline IDs in deterministic insertion order. |
| [start](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.start) | Return a derived instant stamp of all interval starts. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_duration_for](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_duration_for) | Return one stored interval duration with timeline identity. |
| [get_interval](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_interval) | Return one stored interval by timeline identity. |
| [get_interval_in](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_interval_in) | Convert both endpoints of one stored interval to a target unit. |
| [get_intervals](#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_intervals) | Return selected stored intervals in requested order. |

### get_duration_for { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_duration_for }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp.get_duration_for(timeline_id)
```

Return one stored interval duration with timeline identity.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description               | Default    |
|-------------|--------------|---------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) | Stored timeline identity. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                             | Description                      |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
|        | [IdDuration](`timetoalign.core.time.IdDuration`) | The canonical typed ID duration. |

### get_interval { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_interval }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp.get_interval(timeline_id)
```

Return one stored interval by timeline identity.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description               | Default    |
|-------------|--------------|---------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) | Stored timeline identity. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                         | Description                   |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
|        | [Interval](`timetoalign.core.time.Interval`) | The canonical typed interval. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                |
|--------|------------------------|----------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If the timeline is absent. |

### get_interval_in { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_interval_in }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp.get_interval_in(unit, *, timeline_id=None)
```

Convert both endpoints of one stored interval to a target unit.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                          | Description                                | Default    |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) | Requested target unit.                     | _required_ |
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) \| None                          | Optional stored axis to select explicitly. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                         | Description                          |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | [Interval](`timetoalign.core.time.Interval`) | A typed interval in the target unit. |

### get_intervals { #timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp.get_intervals }

```python
TimeIntervalStamp.get_intervals(timeline_ids=None)
```

Return selected stored intervals in requested order.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                | Description                                          | Default   |
|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| timeline_ids | [KeyCollection](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.KeyCollection`) \| None | Timeline IDs, or ``None`` for every stored interval. | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                         | Description                        |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Interval](`timetoalign.core.time.Interval`)\] | A new ordered interval dictionary. |
